name: Hebei Huatong Wires and Cables Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hebei Huatong Wires and Cables Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of wires and cables in China and internationally. It operates through Cable Sector, Oil and Gas Sector, and Aluminum Sector segments. The company offers ESP cables, mining cables, rubber cables, low voltage power cables, medium voltage power cables, electrical equipment cables, as well as new energy and other cables; and umbilical tubes, intelligent coiled tubing, intelligent flat pack, ESPCP, and specialized oil and gas service vehicles.
